Definition: Overall cohort: 152 genomes. Primary reference-group comparisons: 144 genomes (23 subflava, 114 perflava, 7 flavescens). Eight species-unresolved genomes are retained in overall analyses and excluded from primary comparisons among reference-assigned groups.
Species names denote operational reference assignments. ANI_reference_assignment records the ANI reference channel; analysis_group additionally accounts for unresolved species status.
ANI values are percentages; AF is a proportion. The perflava channel uses the better of two CCUG 17915 assemblies. ANI margin is in percentage points.
subflava: GCA_005221305.1; perflava: GCA_023472875.1 / GCA_042649725.1; flavescens: GCA_005221285.1. GGDC Formula 2 uses the first perflava assembly.

The 1,303-record ledger uses final exclusion decisions: 327 ANI candidates, 243 source/QC-eligible records, 169 dereplicated representatives, and 152 retained genomes. Margins are supplied for the 169 representatives.
Counts summarize grouping of the same 243 eligible genomes at 5, 10, 20 and 50 SNPs, before the final unique-reference filter; they are not alternative final main-cohort sizes.

Blank/NR denotes unavailable or unreported information, not biological absence. Participant and unit identifiers are study-scoped; 152 units are not asserted to be fully independent epidemiological observations.

Membership sensitivity was evaluated within the existing 152-genome cohort using GCA_023472875.1 as the sole perflava reference. The subflava (GCA_005221305.1) and flavescens (GCA_005221285.1) references were unchanged. Mean bidirectional ANI >=95% and minimum directional AF >=0.70 in at least one channel were required.

ANI_directional_scores contains the existing bidirectional FastANI v1.34 scores and fragment counts used in this sensitivity analysis. g2r denotes study genome as query and reference as target; r2g denotes the reverse. matched_fraction = matched_fragments/total_fragments. Mean ANI is the arithmetic mean of the two directional scores; channel AF is the lower matched_fraction. Membership decisions use unrounded values.

All 152 retained genomes passed the membership criteria; none lost eligibility. All 114 primary perflava genomes qualified against GCA_023472875.1. The lowest qualifying mean ANI was 95.0072% (GCA_052858825.1); the lowest qualifying minimum AF was 0.792717 (GCA_042557545.1).

ANI_single_reference links the directional scores to membership decisions. This analysis checks eligibility of the retained cohort only. It does not repeat the initial 1,303-record screen, evaluate other single-reference choices or the mean across both perflava assemblies, or revise primary operational assignments and unresolved species status. The original perflava maximum-of-two rule remains documented in Genome_metadata.
